# Changelog

## 0.3.0

- Open a fresh side draft from selected chat text with the **Side Questions** context-menu item on supported PI-Desktop builds.
- Remove the excerpt in one click or send it with a question to start a fresh conversation. Earlier supported builds continue to offer the paste flow.

## 0.2.0

- Paste a text excerpt into a fresh side conversation. The first question carries the full excerpt and starts with an empty transcript.
- Preview the excerpt as a short chip and remove the whole reference before sending.

## 0.1.0

- Start a side conversation from a completed assistant reply in the work panel.
- Reopen branch history, continue asking questions, and stop a branch independently.
- Handle branch tool permissions, Agent questions, and confirmed deletion through PI-Desktop.
